concepts.a:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: raster enemy sprite concept sheet for a Chinese wuxing survival game.
Reference image 1 is the CURRENT game's pixel-art screenshot, for STYLE AND SCALE ONLY. Reference image 2 is an already-approved concept sheet from the same game: match its exact rendering style (chunky pixel clusters, bright flat material colors, dark plum outer outline, 2-3 shade clusters per material, large simple highlights, shallow three-quarter top-down view), and its subject scale inside each cell. Enemies face RIGHT. NOT high-detail painterly art, not 3D, not realistic. No texture noise. Design at roughly 48-64px worth of information, later reduction will test 24-32px.
One 1536x1024 landscape sheet, EXACTLY SIX isolated subjects, strict THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Wide gutters. Every entire subject inside central 70% of its own equal grid cell; no overlaps. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND (PNG with alpha): no backdrop, no vignette, no glow or halo. No scenery, ground, particles, projectiles, shadows, foot rings, cell borders, labels or text. Camera and light upper-left consistent across all.
A recognizable monster is more important than ornament. Strong silhouette holes between limbs. Compact, slightly cute but threatening. All bodies opaque.
LEVELS 7-8 (FROZEN RIVER, DESERT). Six cells:
TOP LEFT: ICE SILKWORM (water). A plump caterpillar/silkworm larva, FIVE clearly separated round body segments in a gentle arch, frost-white and pale ice-blue body with periwinkle shading, a row of FOUR translucent-looking but OPAQUE pale cyan ice crystal spikes along the back, round head on the RIGHT with two small black bead eyes and two short antennae, tiny stubby legs under each segment. Not a centipede, not a cloud. Fits a 32x24 sprite.
TOP CENTER: IRON PINCER CRAB (metal). Wide flat iron-grey crab carapace seen 3/4 from the side, a thin dull-gold rim along the shell edge, two yellow eyes on short stalks, ONE oversized raised pincer in front on the RIGHT with bright silver tips, one smaller pincer, EIGHT thin jointed walking legs splayed with clear gaps. Heavy armored look. No spikes, no barnacles.
TOP RIGHT: XUANMING BOSS, northern water god from Shanhaijing: HUMAN FACE ON A BIRD BODY. Big dark navy-black bird body standing upright, two huge spread wings with layered feathers whose outer third is frost white, a pale solemn human face with black hair in a topknot and icy blue eyes, a small GREEN SNAKE hanging from each ear like an earring, and two GREEN SNAKES coiled under its talons. Use a much bigger BOSS body within the cell than the regular monsters, keep margins. Tested at 56x56 pixels.
BOTTOM LEFT: SAND SCORPION (earth). Ochre sand-yellow armored scorpion, low segmented body, FIVE-segment tail curled high over the back ending in a black stinger with a red tip pointing forward, two pincers reaching RIGHT, eight thin legs. Clear negative space under the tail arch.
BOTTOM CENTER: GOLDEN SCARAB (metal). A dung beetle with a big round glossy gold shell split by one dark center seam, one short horn on the head pointing RIGHT, small red eye, six spiky dark legs with clear gaps. No ball, no wings open.
BOTTOM RIGHT: HANBA BOSS, the drought demon: "human body, two to three feet tall, naked, ONE EYE ON TOP OF ITS HEAD, walks like the wind". A gaunt emaciated humanoid striding RIGHT, cracked parched ochre-tan skin with dark crack lines, visible ribs, a ragged short loincloth, wild dry grey hair bursting upward and outward, a single large yellow eye on the very top of the skull, wide grim mouth, very long thin arms hanging past the knees ending in hooked claws, long thin legs mid-stride. Bigger BOSS body within the cell, keep margins. Tested at 48x56 pixels.

LEVELS 8-10 (DESERT BOSS SECOND FORM, EAST SEA ABYSS, KUNLUN). Six cells:
TOP LEFT: HANBA BOSS FIRE FORM. Exactly the same gaunt one-eyed drought demon as reference 3 BOTTOM RIGHT (same pose, proportions, single eye on top of skull, long clawed arms, loincloth), but ignited: charred dark red-black skin with bright orange-yellow glowing crack lines, and the wild hair replaced by bursting orange-yellow FLAMES (opaque flat flame shapes, no glow halo). Eye glowing white-yellow. Bigger BOSS body, keep margins. Tested at 48x56 pixels.
TOP CENTER: YAKSHA SEA DEMON (water). A hunched lean sea demon crouching forward ready to pounce RIGHT, cobalt-blue skin, wild white hair, two white tusks, yellow eyes, holding a golden three-pronged trident diagonally across the body, clawed feet. Clear gaps between arms, legs and trident shaft.
TOP RIGHT: FLAME OCTOPUS (fire). A red-orange octopus with a round dome head topped by a small crest of flat yellow flames, one big pale glowing eye facing RIGHT, SIX thick curling tentacles splayed on the ground with golden-yellow flame tips. Opaque body.
BOTTOM LEFT: JIUYING BOSS WATER FORM, the nine-infant water-fire monster. ONE compact coiled deep sea-blue beast body low on the ground, with NINE short separate necks rising in three fans of three, each ending in a ROUND chubby INFANT-like face (pale cream face, tiny closed or crying mouth), the nine heads wear alternating BLUE and RED rounded caps/hoods. Heads clearly NOT snakes (must not resemble a hydra of snakes). Bigger BOSS body, keep margins. Tested at 56x56.
BOTTOM CENTER: JIUYING BOSS FIRE FORM, exactly the same creature and pose as BOTTOM LEFT, but the coiled body is burnt crimson-red with dark maroon shading and the eyes on the body glow amber. Same nine infant heads with alternating blue and red caps.
BOTTOM RIGHT: DIJIANG BOSS, the primordial chaos god from Shanhaijing: "like a YELLOW SACK, red like cinnabar fire, SIX LEGS and FOUR WINGS, featureless with NO FACE, knows song and dance". A big round plump golden-yellow sack-shaped body with NO eyes, NO mouth, NO face at all, a glowing cinnabar-red patch on its underside, two pairs of pale feathered wings (four wings) spread up and back, six thin dark legs in a dancing step. Bigger BOSS body, keep margins. Tested at 56x56.
concepts.b-refine:

Edit ONLY the BOTTOM LEFT and BOTTOM CENTER creatures (the two nine-infant-headed bosses, blue form and red form) in the supplied six-creature sheet.
Each of them currently shows SEVEN infant heads; each must have EXACTLY NINE. Add TWO more short necks with round chubby infant faces (one with a blue cap, one with a red cap) per creature, filling open gaps at the outer left and outer right lower edges of the head cluster, same size and style as the existing heads, so the nine heads read as three fans of three. Keep a clear dark/transparent separation between heads so all NINE can be counted. Both forms must have identical head arrangement.
Keep the existing seven heads and the coiled body. Do not remove or merge any heads.
Preserve the other FOUR creatures pixel-for-pixel as closely as possible. Preserve all grid positions, scale, transparent background, colors and style. No text, no effects or extra objects. Keep transparent alpha (PNG RGBA, corners alpha 0).
concepts.jiuying-2026-10-22:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: raster boss sprite concept for a Chinese wuxing survival game. Reference image 1 is the approved style sheet (match its chunky pixel clusters, bright flat material colors, dark plum outer outline, 2-3 shade clusters per material, three-quarter top-down view, facing RIGHT). Reference image 2 is the previous version of this boss (bottom left = water form, bottom center = fire form): keep its identity (coiled sea-beast body, round chubby infant faces with alternating BLUE and RED rounded caps), but it WRONGLY HAS ONLY EIGHT HEADS.
One 1536x1024 landscape image, EXACTLY TWO isolated subjects side by side: LEFT = WATER FORM (deep sea-blue coiled body with pale-blue water-wave fins), RIGHT = FIRE FORM (identical creature and pose, crimson-red body with orange flame fins, amber body eyes). Wide transparent gutter between them. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND, no backdrop, no glow, no shadows, no text.
HEAD COUNT IS THE PRIORITY: EACH creature has EXACTLY NINE (9) heads. Arrange them as THREE ROWS OF THREE on separate short necks rising from the single coiled body: BACK ROW 3 heads (highest), MIDDLE ROW 3 heads, FRONT ROW 3 heads (lowest, just above the coil). Caps alternate blue, red, blue / red, blue, red / blue, red, blue. Every head is the same size, a separate round face with its own cap, with a clear dark or transparent gap separating it from its neighbours so all NINE can be counted at a glance. Do not overlap faces. 3 + 3 + 3 = 9 heads per creature, 18 heads total in the image.
Big boss body, fills most of its half, keep margins. Will be reduced to 80x80 pixels; the nine heads must stay countable.

motion.5:
Use case: identity-preserve sprite animation. The attached image is a numbered identity reference board containing SIX already-approved game creatures (read the items left-to-right, top-to-bottom as 1 through 6). Produce ONE TRANSPARENT ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET, exactly FOUR columns and SIX rows (24 isolated full-body sprites). Row N contains only creature N from the reference, repeated in 4 genuinely different locomotion key poses, read left-to-right. Portrait canvas, regular equal-size cells, all sprites fully within their cells with generous transparent gaps. No labels, text, frames, grid lines, scenery or shadows.
Preserve the approved character designs VERY closely: same head and face, materials, palette, slenderness, clothing/weapons, perspective, and simple chunky pixel-art shading. All creatures face to the RIGHT throughout. This is locomotion, not a turntable and not an attack animation. Keep each character's body size and head size absolutely identical across its four cells, keep its torso centered, and keep a consistent invisible ground baseline. Pose changes must come from articulated legs/arms/wings/tail, never from simply stretching, squashing, or translating the whole cutout. Use clear contact, passing/push, opposite contact, and return phases that loop. Feet visibly alternate support vs lift. Ground bodies have modest weight transfer, not a big jump (except the toad). Make pose differences obvious enough to survive reduction to 32px sprites. Transparent alpha background. No extra creatures, no omitted or duplicated rows. Exactly 6 rows x 4 columns.
ROW 1: the plump frost-white ICE SILKWORM: a caterpillar inching crawl — segments bunch up into a hump that travels from tail to head, then the front stretches forward; tiny legs alternate; ice crystals on the back stay attached and ride the hump. Head and antennae stable.
ROW 2: the iron-grey PINCER CRAB: a sideways scuttle — the eight thin legs move in two alternating groups (one group planted, the other lifted), the big silver claw lifts and lowers slightly, eye stalks stable. Shell stays level.
ROW 3: XUANMING, the human-faced bird boss with green snakes: a hovering wingbeat cycle — wings fully up / mid downstroke / fully down / mid upstroke, while the body, solemn face and the snakes under its talons stay in place; the ear snakes sway slightly. Keep its large boss size identical in every cell.
ROW 4: the ochre SAND SCORPION: walking — legs alternate in two groups, pincers bob forward and back, the high curled tail sways forward and back with the stinger; body low and level.
ROW 5: the GOLDEN SCARAB beetle: walking — the six spiky legs move in alternating tripods (front-left/middle-right/rear-left vs the others), shell rocks very slightly, horn stable.
ROW 6: HANBA, the gaunt one-eyed drought demon: a long striding walk — legs alternate long strides (contact, passing, opposite contact, passing), very long clawed arms counter-swing, wild grey hair streams back, single eye on top of the skull stays. Keep its large boss size identical in every cell.

TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND (PNG RGBA, corners alpha 0). No backdrop, no glow.
